notes: The ketiv/qere unit is underdetermined with no exclusion mark, so the projection is aligned as prepared (rules 9, 53).

One written אִם governs both members of the protasis: the waw takes *And* and the אִם's *if* is rewritten over the second clause as one discontinuous unit (rule 55's closing paragraph, rule 25). The single לֹא is distributed the same way, since the second Hebrew clause writes no negative of its own (rule 25).
